ship.yaw_steady_deg_s.HALF.reason: Phase 2: first-order Nomoto steering, r = K (V/L) delta, makes the steady turn rate linear in speed, so the turning circle is nearly constant; calibrated at FULL (1.2 deg/s), HALF becomes 0.75 deg/s.
